blends.name: Collector Reward 1 | Trio
blends.desc:
The ingredients for this can be found [in this drop](https://neftyblocks.com/c/shootforlove). Blender Packs have a 5% chance of containing a token (numbered 1-10) and Collectors Boxes each contain *five guaranteed* tokens (numbered 1-10). This is the first of ten planned events, only the number one token can be used in this recipe.

**Inside these pre-minted Collector rewards is a single NFT:**
150–*Base* Rarities
15–*Stellar* Rarities each backed with 65 WAX
1–*Inglorious* Rarity Backed 974 WAX

-[See the WAX backing and pre-minting as broadcasted on Twitch.tv](https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1213133404?t=00h19m18s)
-[Come share your results on our Discord!](https://discord.gg/r69VGE6Zxt)
-[Check the Collection Details](https://www.shootforlove.com/)
